data.title: 菲亚梅塔 · 节目单背面
data.description: 节目单背面被熟人画了个小人。菲亚梅塔盯着它看了一会儿，把纸折好放进包里。
data.camera: 中景，节目单与台阶同框
data.promptProse: Standing in the ornate, high-ceilinged foyer of a historic theater, Fiammetta holds a folded program in both hands, glancing down at it as she takes a quiet moment before the show. Soft, elegant ambient lighting reflects off the polished marble floors, gilded ceiling moldings, and large art deco posters on the walls, creating a refined, serene atmosphere.
